name: Octopus specimen
species: Octopus sp. (species not specified by creator)
creator: rayleighsyafiq
educationalRole: One octopus example for the broad invertebrate concept. It is not a local-fauna claim and does not represent all invertebrates.
modifications: Converted KHR_materials_pbrSpecularGlossiness to core metallic/roughness PBR so the site renderer preserves the source coloration.
Textures resized to a 512 px maximum and encoded as WebP at quality 82.
Geometry quantized with glTF Transform 4.5.1; no mesh reduction was applied.
limitations: The Sketchfab listing does not identify an exact octopus species.
The model is static and should be animated with camera/lighting transitions rather than implying authored locomotion.
Source creator attribution is shown beside the lesson model.
